sentences.en: The landscape was a measureless yellow mass of flourishing sunflowers.
sentences.zh: 这片景色是一片无边无际盛开的向日葵。

sentences.en: In recent years, secular ideas have flourished throughout the region.
sentences.zh: 近年来，世俗思想在该地区蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: Those trees we planted on the church grounds are flourishing.
sentences.zh: 我们种在教堂地上的那些树长势喜人。

senses.zh: 兴旺；茂盛；挥舞；炫耀；华饰
繁荣，兴旺；茂盛；活跃；处于旺盛时期

mnemonic: 词根记忆：flour（花）+ish（使…）→花一样开放→繁荣
